title: Swimming Pools at Shanty Creek
new_html:
Whether you're cooling off in summer or relaxing after a day on the slopes, Shanty Creek has pools across its villages.

  • The Lakeview Hotel (Summit Village) – indoor pool (open daily 9am–11pm) and a seasonal outdoor pool (summer only).
  • The Lodge at Cedar River – heated outdoor pool and hot tubs, reserved for Cedar River lodging guests and property owners.

Your pool pass covers the Lakeview Hotel indoor and outdoor pools only. The other village pools are not included with your stay.

Pool towels are provided only to Shanty Creek lodging guests, so please bring your own towels.

title: Biking
new_html:
Antrim County is a cyclist’s dream, whether you prefer the road or rugged trails.

  • Road Biking: Ride the quiet, rolling hills and scenic byways with minimal traffic and stunning views.
  • Mountain Biking: Explore Glacial Hills, one of Michigan’s premier trail systems with loops for all skill levels.
  • E-Bike Rentals (summer season): New to biking or want help with the hills? Rent a motor-assisted e-bike from the Summit Fitness Center: 6 hours $65, 12 hours $132. Pick-up 9am–5pm; call 231-533-7060.
  • Traditional Bikes are also available for cruising around the resort.

More info: https://www.shantycreek.com/stay/fitness-center/

title: Hiking
new_html:
Looking for a scenic workout? Shanty Creek offers hiking experiences for every pace and preference:

  • Schuss Mountain Trails – Tackle a summertime climb for a rewarding hike with panoramic views of northern Michigan.
  • Grass River Natural Area – Just a short drive away, this network of trails winds through forests, wetlands, and along the water’s edge. It's perfect for peaceful nature walks and wildlife spotting.

Whether you're in it for fitness or fresh air, these trails highlight the natural beauty of the region.

More info: https://www.shantycreek.com/stay/more-fun-in-the-sun/

title: After Dark | Outdoor Movies + Stargazing
new_html:
When the sun goes down, the fun doesn’t stop at Shanty Creek.

Outdoor Movies on the Mountain
On select summer Saturday nights, the resort has hosted family-friendly outdoor movies atop Summit Mountain. Check the events calendar or ask the front desk for upcoming dates.

Stargazing in Northern Michigan
Clear skies bring out a whole new show: the stars. Far from city lights, Shanty Creek is a great place to spot constellations, shooting stars, and if you're lucky, the Northern Lights.

Tip: Dress warm and bring a thermos. Even summer nights can get cool at the top.

More info: https://www.shantycreek.com/stay/more-fun-in-the-sun/

title: Schuss Mountain Trail Map
new_html:
Welcome to Schuss Mountain at Shanty Creek Resort, where terrain, trails, and fun come together.

Schuss Mountain has about 42 trails for all skill levels, with groomed runs, glades, two terrain parks, and great views across the mountain.

Trail difficulty

  • ● Green circle – Easiest: wide, gentle slopes for beginners
  • ■ Blue square – More difficult: for developing skiers
  • ◆ Black diamond – Most difficult: steeper, faster terrain and glades

Lifts

  • Five chairlifts – Pink, Blue, Yellow, Purple, and Red
  • Purple Lift – Rises from Cedar River Village for ski-in/ski-out access
  • Red Lift – Serves the back side of the mountain
  • Surface lifts – Magic carpet and handle tow for beginners and the small terrain park

Terrain parks

  • Mellow Yellow – The main park: big boxes, rails, and jumps
  • Low Rider – A smaller, handle-tow park near the Yellow Lift for building confidence

Key areas

  • Schuss Village – Base area with day lodge, tickets, rentals, ski school, and Ivan’s
  • Cedar River Village – Ski-in/ski-out lodging next to the Purple Lift

Tips for Visitors

  • Start your day early for fresh corduroy runs
  • Green trails near the base are best for families and beginners
  • Use lift maps and signage to plan your route across the mountain
  • Helmets are recommended for all riders

title: Nordic Trail Map
new_html:
Explore the snow-covered beauty of Shanty Creek Resort on its scenic Nordic ski and snowshoe trails. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced skier, these trails offer a peaceful and invigorating way to enjoy winter.

Trail overview (2026 map)

  • Pine Cone – 4.5 km, Schuss Village
  • Winter Brook – 1.5 km, Schuss Village
  • Arnie’s Way – 1 km, Summit Village
  • Summit Loop – 1 km, Summit Village
  • Multi-purpose trail – 3 km groomed trail at Schuss Village for snowshoeing and fat tire biking

Trails are marked by difficulty (easiest, moderate, difficult) with trailhead signs. Landmarks along the way include Red Lift Corner, Riverview, and #3 Tee.

Nordic Center hours (2026–27 season, projected Dec 26 – Mar 13):

  • Thu & Mon: 9am – 4pm
  • Fri: 10am – 4pm
  • Sat, Sun & holidays: 9am – 5pm
  • Closed: Tue & Wed

title: Skiing & Snowboarding
new_html:
Shanty Creek Resort is one of Michigan’s most beloved ski destinations. Schuss Mountain has about 42 downhill trails, five chairlifts, and two terrain parks, making it ideal for skiers and snowboarders of all skill levels. Alpine tubing is next door at Summit Mountain.

Whether you’re a beginner looking for gentle runs or a seasoned skier chasing fresh powder and steeps, the variety of terrain, well-maintained conditions, and laid-back vibe deliver exactly what you need.

2026–27 season (projected): opens Dec 5, 2026; daily skiing from Dec 12; night skiing from Dec 26; closes Mar 22, 2027.

Hours: Sun 9am–4:30pm; Mon–Tue 10am–4:30pm; Wed–Sat and holidays 9am–9pm (once night skiing begins).

More info: https://www.shantycreek.com/ski/ | Hours of operation

title: Nordic Skiing
new_html:
Few activities capture the quiet beauty of northern Michigan in winter quite like Nordic skiing. At Shanty Creek Resort, you’ll find 9.5 km of groomed, track-set cross-country trails that wind between the resort’s villages for a scenic, heart-healthy village-to-village skiing experience.

Multi-purpose trail: If Nordic skiing isn’t your thing, a 3 km groomed trail in Schuss Village is set aside for fat tire biking and snowshoeing.

Nordic Center: Classic and skate ski rentals and snowshoe rentals. Day trail pass $22 adult / $14 child; ski packages $34 adult; snowshoes $28.

Hours (2026–27, projected Dec 26 – Mar 13): Thu & Mon 9am–4pm; Fri 10am–4pm; Sat, Sun & holidays 9am–5pm; closed Tue & Wed.

Lessons: Book 48 hours ahead. Cancellations need 48 hours’ notice for a refund. Requests for a specific instructor need at least 3 days’ notice.

More info: https://www.shantycreek.com/ski/nordic-trails/

title: Alpine Tubing
new_html:
If skiing and snowboarding aren’t your thing, there’s still a fast and fun way to enjoy the snow. Alpine Tubing at Summit Mountain is a must-try winter activity, with all the thrills of sledding and none of the uphill climb.

You’ll hear laughter echoing across the slopes as guests of all ages race down the tubing lanes and ride the surface lift back to the top. No skills required. Just hold on and enjoy the ride!

What to know:

  • Sessions start at the top of every hour
  • $30 per hour
  • Online booking only
  • Participants must be 36″ tall

Hours (2026–27, projected Dec 19 – Mar 14): Fri 4pm–10pm; Sat & holidays 10am–10pm; Sun & holiday Mondays 10am–4pm.

Parents note: The last two hours on Friday and Saturday nights are recommended for adults only.

More info & booking: https://www.shantycreek.com/ski/more-on-the-snow/#tubing

title: Fat Tire Biking
new_html:
Ride on, even in the snow

Try fat tire biking on the groomed 3 km multi-purpose trail at Schuss Village. Whether you're an experienced rider or just looking to try something new, this packed trail offers a smooth, scenic ride through snow-covered landscapes. It’s shared with snowshoers.

Don’t have your own bike? Fat tire bike rentals are available from Paddles & Pedals, 206 N. Bridge St. in downtown Bellaire. Call 231-533-4449 to reserve and confirm winter availability.

title: Snow Glide Tours
new_html:
Experience winter like never before with Shanty Creek’s Snow Glide Tours, a scenic, cozy, and memorable ride for all ages.

Tours depart from The Lakeview Hotel's front circle. Each 45-minute guided ride winds through the snow-blanketed landscapes of Summit Village, with sweeping views and no effort required.

Each tour seats up to 9 passengers and is pulled behind “Big Blue,” a double-track snowmobile. The Snow Glide has seatbelts, and passengers must be able to sit independently while buckled.

Schedule (last season): on the hour, 10am–3pm, on Saturdays, Sundays, and select holiday dates. The 2026–27 schedule had not been posted as of Oct 2026.

Price: $29 per seat
Seating is limited, so book early. Questions: 231-533-3000.

More info & booking: https://www.shantycreek.com/snow-glide-tours/

by Arnold Palmer

Arnold Palmer helped introduce northern Michigan golf to the world when Golf Magazine named it among the “Top Resort Courses” in the US. 4½ stars from Golf Digest.

title: The Lakeview Hotel
new_html:
Enjoy the heart of Summit Village at the Lakeview Hotel, perched above Lake Bellaire with views for miles. Even if you're not staying at the hotel, it's the resort's hub for dining, pools, and events.

Dining

  • The Lakeview – bar and grill fare with sunset views over Lake Bellaire. Breakfast daily 7–11am; lunch daily 11:30am–4pm; dinner Sun–Thu 5–9pm, Fri–Sat 5–10pm; bar opens daily at 11:30am; happy hour daily 5–6:30pm.
  • CoffeeBAR (proudly serving Starbucks) – in the Great Room lobby. Sun–Thu 7am–2pm, Fri–Sat 7am–6pm.

Pools

  • Your pool pass covers the Lakeview indoor pool (open daily 9am–11pm) and the seasonal outdoor pool. Bring your own towels.

Nearby in Summit Village

  • Tennis courts, the children's playground, and The Legend and Summit golf courses
  • Alpine tubing and Snow Glide Tours in winter

Address: 5780 Shanty Creek Road, Bellaire, MI 49615
Phone: 231-533-3000
